memories.content: The user's maternal aunt keeps one spare key to the user's home.
If the door is locked, the user is accustomed to contacting their maternal aunt, who has the spare key, before contacting building management.
When going to collect the spare key from their maternal aunt, the user wants to give an arrival time first so neither person has to wait.
The user feels at ease only after returning a borrowed spare key in person on the same day.
The user feels uneasy about writing down a new entrance passcode on paper.
The user found it difficult when a family member arrived without notice during a meeting and the user could not respond immediately.
On a day their younger brother received a package for them, the user felt reassured after checking the delivery photo.
The user's maternal aunt wants confirmation that the user is coming in person before handing over the spare key.
Confirm with the user before sharing the spare key's storage location or the maternal aunt's contact information.
The management office of a multi-unit residential building does not hold a unit key without verifying identity.
The user keeps a portable fan charger on a living-room shelf.
On a hot day, the user worked with only the window open and lost focus in the afternoon.
In the room where the user closed the curtains the next morning, the temperature rose less.
The user took the portable fan out without charging it, and it turned off after an hour.
Before the next outing, the user charged it the night before and used the fan throughout the trip.
On a hot weekend, the user was eating lunch in their father's yard and moved indoors.
When the user returned to the yard in the evening, shade and wind led them to stay another hour.
The user's father prefers to move an outdoor meal to the evening rather than proceed at midday when the temperature is high.
The local agent can compare past responses to heat but cannot know the current felt temperature without an indoor temperature record.
A room with a west-facing window can warm rapidly in the late afternoon.
